h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mangalore

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mangalore

items.pText: Mangalore receives some of the heaviest monsoon rain of any city on the west coast, from June well into September. Add the port, the sea breeze and the laterite soil, and you have a site that tests every outdoor material. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 750 km up the coast, and sends it to Dakshina Kannada by road.

The city's colleges, schools, housing projects and seaside hotels make up most of our enquiries here. Send us your site size, the age group and a few photos taken in both dry and wet weather if you have them. We will suggest equipment and a layout with the safe play area marked, then install through our own team or a dealer once you approve.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Drainage first in a Mangalore monsoon

c: With this much rain, drainage decides whether a playground is usable for four months of the year. Build the play area on a raised base with a clear slope towards a drain, and avoid corners where runoff from roofs collects. Laterite is firm when dry and holds grouted posts well, but loose fill around the footings washes out quickly in heavy rain, so compact it properly.

items.q: How do we keep a Mangalore playground usable in the monsoon?
items.a: Raise the base, slope it towards a drain and lay rubber flooring. Keep the play area away from roof runoff, which floods low corners in heavy rain.

items.q: Does FunPlay supply hotels and colleges in Mangalore?
items.a: Yes. We supply hotels, colleges, schools and housing projects. The equipment is made in Vasai and installed by our team or a regional dealer.

items.q: Is laterite soil suitable for grouted installation?
items.a: Yes, laterite holds concrete footings well when it is compacted. Loose fill around the posts should be avoided, since heavy rain washes it out.
